slides.heading: Simple Function Testing
slides.body: Simple Function Testing is part of Functions and Modularity. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Simple Function Testing
slides.body: Simple function testing checks whether a function returns or prints the expected result. It helps catch mistakes early.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Testing a function is like tasting food before serving it to make sure the recipe worked.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A good function should do one clear task and have a name that explains that task.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Create a simple test that checks if triple(3) equals 9.
